skeptic.objection: This parcel is not open industrial land. It is the site of a data center project by its owner. The owner is that developer's numbered project LLC, which paid $23.5M in January 2024, about $1.1M an acre against a $57,863/acre assessor land value. The regional review (DRI 4257, closed February 2025) names this exact parcel. Georgia EPD issued an air quality permit on 05/06/2025 for the construction and operation of 66 emergency generators for a data processing facility at 4380 Stacks Road, the lead's site address. A developer holding permitted land for its own hyperscale project is neither a seller nor a land-priced industrial target. That holds unless a person finds the project dead, and even then the owner's cost basis is roughly 20 times the assessed land value.
